title: Filtering Txt = "e" over e, é, E keeps e and E but not é
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Accent, Accent[Txt] = "e" ) ) )

source.quote: By default, the comparison between strings is case-insensitive and accent-sensitive
source.supports: the default comparison ignores case and respects accents; the page gives "e" and "è" as different

source.quote: The engine that stores and queries data in Power BI is case insensitive, and treats different capitalization of letters as the same value
source.supports: text that differs only in case is the same value, for comparison and for storage

derivation: Accent[Txt] holds e (Id 1), é (Id 2), E (Id 3). = ignores case, so rows 1 and 3 equal "e". It does not ignore accents, so row 2 does not. 2 rows. An accent-insensitive comparison would give 3.
